title: Single Airport BB Stem XXL
description:
Single Airport BB Stem XXL
This Extra long glass BB stem produes some very smooth and satisfying vapour depending on your technique of course.
What gives the XXL its characteristics is the small glass balls trapped inside and the few indents that hold the balls in place. These obstacles create turbulence as the vapour is sucked through the stem which cools and conditions the vapour.
﻿Please Note: Airport on current version is located in the centre for more comfortable use.
Dynavap tip NOT included
Included
1 x Single Airport BB Stem XXL
